scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm source:check && pnpm build:packages && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @lenso/testing test:browser && pnpm --filter @lenso/testing test:integration
scripts.dev:docs: turbo run build --filter=@lenso/ui --filter=@lenso/tokens --output-logs=errors-only && turbo run dev --filter=@lenso/ui-docs...
scripts.dev:storybook: turbo run build --filter=@lenso/ui --filter=@lenso/tokens --output-logs=errors-only && turbo run dev --filter=@lenso/storybook...
scripts.test: pnpm test:scripts && pnpm test:ci && turbo run test
scripts.test:production: turbo run build --filter=@lenso/storybook && pnpm --filter @lenso/storybook test:browser rtl && pnpm --filter @lenso/testing test:package && pnpm --filter @lenso/stylex-build test:next
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:scripts && pnpm typecheck:ci && turbo run typecheck
